theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_coarea_cc_small_lip_partition
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : Eucl n → ℝ) (E : Set (Eucl n)) (ε : ℝ≥0), ContDiff ℝ 1 h → MeasurableSet E → (∀ w ∈ E, fderiv ℝ h w = 0) → 0 < ε → ∃ D : ℕ → Set (Eucl n), (∀ k, MeasurableSet (D k)) ∧ Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint D) ∧ (⋃ k, D k) = E ∧ ∀ k, LipschitzOnWith ε h (D k)
